changeinfo.changes:
New Feature: 3/4-Player-mode - Add support for up to 4 players in local drop-in/drop-out co-op (increased from previous max of 2 players) - Update arena population across game for 3/4P mode
General Co-op Enhancements: - Adjust co-op camera positioning in some areas, to provide better view of what's ahead - Update auto-bubble-due-to-long-fall tolerances with custom per-camera-zone settings - Increase general bubble movement speed, for easier un-bubbling - Have players inherit active move of bubble target when un-bubbling - When dimension-swap is blocked by one or more players: Flash blocking players - Update Temple of Rain dimension-swap portals to fail immediately if swap is blocked by another player - Disable low-health warning sound in co-op - Disable Temple of Rain portals for a brief period of time after a dimension swap - In co-op play, normal difficulty, when a player hits insta-kill lava while others are alive, have the player bubble (not die) - Auto-bubble players who try to go back to previous camera zone within 1 second of having exited it in co-op (helps with camera contention issues) - Add subtle "wall slime" indicators to other-dimension hull visuals throughout game, as appropriate
Progression Blocker Fixes: - Fix for progression-blocking bug that could occur if players entered Pico, then backtracked to Sierra before obtaining Goat-Fly - Fix for progression-blocking bug that could occur if players quit out during boat sequence of Canal - Fix for progression-blocking bug that could occur if players broke a red uppercut block at the bottom of the Tule Tree from above (resulting in inability to obtain Double-jump later in the level) - Fix for progression-blocking bug in bar in Santa-Luchita (if players quit out and re-loaded in/around bar scene) - Fix for progression-blocking bug that could occur if you quit after the forced progression arena in Pico de Gallo - Fix for progression-blocking bug where players could in some circumstances load into the chicken-only portion of the Desert as a human
Other Bug fixes: - Fix for soft-lock that could occur in El Trio boss battle - Fix for noticeable delay/latency when opening or closing pause menu (Note: This latency seems to be related to a system update that was released after the game's launch) - Fix for Camposanto side-quest re-playing final door-opening sequence after quest is complete - Fix for soft-lock bug where elite enemies sometimes fail to re-appear after teleporting out - Fixes to errors with fading geo in IAMERROR's house - Fix for misaligned damage-zone in Pico de Gallo hard mode - Fix for calibration screen healing you fully - Fix for Calaca Red Shield Shine moving too fast - Fix for (rare) controller-assignment-change soft-lock - Fix for soft-lock when player countdown ends mid Flame Face fight (co-op only) - Fix for soft-lock that could occur around falling stalactite in Canal level (co-op only)
Bug Fix: Fix for crash that can occur if you die repeatedly while fighting the final boss in co-op
